goal: Reconstruct E_rec, x_rec, y_rec, z_rec from the supplied sparse PMT waveforms for 1--10 MeV single-electron events. The sole success target is the frozen evaluator result: R_1MeV <= 3.0%, with the 1 MeV three-dimensional vertex RMS also at or below the numeric threshold in public/evaluation_config.json. Continue researching until this target is reached or you have a defensible scientific conclusion. Infer the detector response from the labeled calibration data, public development data and open literature; do not assume a particular reconstruction method.
gate_block: Only modify src/. Run bash scripts/check_verify.sh for the output-contract gate and bash scripts/bench.sh for the public development score. The solver contract is python3 src/solve.py --data <split> --calibration <split> --out <pred.npz>, writing equally sized finite arrays E_rec, x_rec, y_rec, z_rec. The final evaluator replays the solver on a hidden split, so solutions tied to development truth do not solve the task.
